svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Review run: pool, copies and limits
svg.desc: The reviewer run fans its lenses out over a bounded pool. Each lens owns a read-only copy of the change and is bounded by a per-attempt limit and a whole-run deadline.
